Preconditions: Bare assembled card and drawings available
Procedure: Inspect orientation solder joints contamination fingers connector and mounting
Expected_Result: No visible assembly defect
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No bridge wrong polarity damaged finger or mechanical interference

Procedure: Measure P12V_SLOT P12V_PROTECTED and P3V3_NVME to GND both polarities
Expected_Result: No hard short and readings are recorded
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No near-zero stable resistance unless explained by circuit

Procedure: Feed protected 12V injection point using documented current limit
Expected_Result: Controlled startup without current-limit latch
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No smoke overheating or unexplained current limit

Procedure: Capture P3V3_NVME and PGOOD during power-on
Expected_Result: Rail starts monotonically and PGOOD follows configured threshold
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Measured waveform meets approved PSpice-derived limits

Procedure: Measure 12V input and 3.3V no-load current
Expected_Result: Current is stable and explainable
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Value within calculated no-load budget plus approved tolerance

Procedure: Measure AC-coupled ripple at shunt load side
Expected_Result: No burst or instability inconsistent with selected mode
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Ripple within final power requirement

Preconditions: 3.3V stable and external I2C master connected
Procedure: Scan only approved address then read manufacturer or configuration register
Expected_Result: Device acknowledges at strapped address
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Expected address ACK and no bus contention

Procedure: Read temperature register and compare with ambient reference
Expected_Result: Reading is plausible and stable
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Within datasheet-informed acceptance band after stabilization

Preconditions: Power tests passed and approved SSD installed
Procedure: Cold-start while capturing input output current voltage and PGOOD
Expected_Result: No brownout or protection nuisance trip
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Waveforms meet frozen droop timing and current-limit criteria
Notes: Record exact SSD model and firmware

Procedure: Install card and confirm bracket seating and connector engagement
Expected_Result: Card seats fully without flex or interference
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No mechanical conflict and host remains safe
Notes: Host power remains off during installation

Procedure: Boot OS and capture lspci dmesg or Device Manager evidence
Expected_Result: NVMe endpoint enumerates once without repeated link reset
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Device visible with stable BDF and no fatal PCIe error

Procedure: Capture LnkCap and LnkSta with lspci -vv
Expected_Result: Negotiated speed is recorded
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Gen3 only passes when host slot and SSD both support Gen3 and link is stable

Procedure: Capture LnkCap and LnkSta with lspci -vv
Expected_Result: Negotiated width is recorded
Pass_Fail_Criteria: x4 only passes when host slot and SSD support x4 and all lanes are intact
Notes: x1 or x2 triggers lane diagnosis

Procedure: Run nvme list and nvme id-ctrl or Windows equivalent
Expected_Result: Controller identity and namespace are readable
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Commands complete without timeout or reset

Procedure: Run bounded verified read/write workload on test namespace
Expected_Result: Workload completes without I/O or PCIe error
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Zero unplanned reset and verification error
Notes: Never run destructive workload on user data

Preconditions: Short test passed and cooling configuration documented
Procedure: Run staged workload while logging power temperature SMART and kernel events
Expected_Result: No unplanned disappearance error or thermal emergency
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Criteria defined in storage_stress_test.md before run
Notes: Use FIO-RANDREAD-STRESS then separately approved FIO-MIXED-STRESS from test_profiles.csv

Procedure: Record SSD buck eFuse shunt inlet and ambient temperature
Expected_Result: Temperature reaches stable or bounded trend
Pass_Fail_Criteria: All parts stay inside approved derated limits

Procedure: Perform documented count of full power removals and boots
Expected_Result: Enumeration succeeds consistently
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Zero failure in predeclared trial count

Procedure: Perform documented count of OS restarts and resets
Expected_Result: Endpoint returns after each warm boot
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Zero failure in predeclared trial count
Notes: Use BOOT-WARM-10 from test_profiles.csv and keep evidence separate from cold boot

Procedure: Repeat minimum power enumeration and link suite with second approved SSD
Expected_Result: Results recorded per SSD
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No safety fault and deviations explained

Procedure: Create debug log root-cause evidence and ECO impact assessment
Expected_Result: Anomaly is reproducible or explicitly closed as not reproduced
Pass_Fail_Criteria: ECO has verification plan and regression scope
Notes: Do not assign root cause without evidence
